paragraphs.source_en: For the past four or five days, Naya Shōan had secluded himself in a villa at Chigonomiya, publicly claiming that he had caught a chill and needed rest, though in truth he had another purpose. After Sen no Rikyū's death, no one at Toyotomi Hideyoshi's side dared prevent his expedition to Korea. Shōan was therefore racking his brains over how to meet this new turn of events while gathering news from every quarter here.
